::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Jany 15th 1879  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54921: 79
:::

Miss Yonge would be obliged if [Messrs Macmillan](organizations/other_111.qmd) would send a copy of the [Story of the Christians and Moors](cmy_books/cmybook_126.qmd) to [Madame de Witt](people/person_423.qmd), Boulevarde Hausseman Paris[^1]

---

[^1]: Endorsed 'Post Jan 20'.
